heading: Want to Improve Your Pitch Recognition?
description: Explore these music-learning tools to practise listening carefully, comparing notes and recognizing differences in musical pitch.

products.name: Berklee Music Theory: Book 1
features: Listening exercises for notes, scales and intervals.
Suitable for beginner musicians and self-study.

products.name: Korg CA-2 Chromatic Tuner
features: Displays the pitch of a played musical note.
Useful for checking notes while practising an instrument.

products.name: Yamaha PSS-F30 Mini Keyboard
features: Plays notes at different pitches on demand.
Lets users compare high and low notes repeatedly.
Useful for practising pitch matching and simple melodies.
